What is already decided The contour key stays in the panel: CLIs go to its local gateway, never to the contour itself Client tools cannot be declared to the company platform as a field: the panel declares them to the model as protocol text and reassembles the call out of the answer — an agent through a contour does edit files. A compatible gateway gets them as a field, as the vendor does Not every CLI takes a gateway address: four of the ten document no such setting, and the list shows them as a dash with its reason Compromises (22) Panel agent Write in plain words — the agent does it in the panel with the same actions you would. Every change waits for your confirmation. Conversation History Action trail New conversation Page: Contour Connect the team contour: http://gateway.corp.internal:8080 I will save a contour draft. I never take the key — you type it. Action: Save a contour draft Opened page /platform Save a contour draft: saved, a key is needed — you type it Saved without the key. The panel opened its own field — type the key there, never send it to me. The key field is open in the panel. Contour settings Address and key, a probe of capabilities, the choice of consumers — four steps. 1. Address 2. Key 3. What is available 4. Where to apply Contour key A saved key is never shown — not here, not in any panel response. Leave the field empty to keep the saved one. The key stays in the panel: CLIs go to its local gateway, and the gateway substitutes the key. Where to get the key Everything happens in the contour admin console, usually https://inst.<your-domain>. /providers The model provider is registered and active. /models The model is created and answers in the platform chat. /users The key has an owner — without one company knowledge is out of its reach. /keys The key is created, budget and limits are set, the value is copied. The owner is not a formality: knowledge tools act on their behalf, and a key without an owner finds nothing. Back Next
